ev.q: In 2021, 51.6% of all U.S. children and adolescents aged 5–17 years received free or reduced-cost meals at school during the previous 12 months

Children and adolescents in families with incomes <185% of the FPL were more likely to receive free or reduced-cost meals compared with children and adolescents in families with incomes ≥185% of the FPL
NH Black or African American (66.2%) and Hispanic or Latino (Hispanic) (64.4%) children and adolescents were more likely to receive free or reduced-cost meals at school than were NH White (42.7%)
The same pattern was observed for children and adolescents in families with income ≥185% of the FPL
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
Family income was imputed when missing.
